queries.query: My Bedrock knowledge base returns no sources for any query
queries.rationale: Behavioral retrieval failure on a deployed knowledge base - the primary activation case.

queries.query: Our KB answers are missing documents we uploaded this week
queries.rationale: Stale-answers symptom; routes to the source-vs-last-sync check.

queries.query: The last sync on my knowledge base failed partway through
queries.rationale: Ingestion-job failure; routes to job status/statistics and per-document status.

queries.query: One document never shows up in my knowledge base
queries.rationale: Single-document symptom; routes to the source-layer file rules.

queries.query: Indexing keeps failing on my OpenSearch Serverless knowledge base
queries.rationale: Vector-store symptom scoped to AOSS; routes to collection, network, and data-access policy checks.

queries.query: The KB keeps citing a document we deleted
queries.rationale: Data-source lifecycle symptom; routes to dataDeletionPolicy RETAIN.

queries.query: Why is my Bedrock RAG returning nothing right now
queries.rationale: Acute behavioral failure; the Health-event-first path and the ingestion branch both apply.

queries.query: I get AccessDenied calling InvokeModel from my app
queries.rationale: IAM access failure, not a KB pipeline fault - hands off to aiml-access-diagnostics.

queries.query: Review whether my knowledge base is configured to best practices
queries.rationale: Pre-deployment posture review - belongs to bedrock-operation-review, not reactive diagnosis.

queries.query: Help me create and configure a new Bedrock knowledge base
queries.rationale: Build/configure request; this skill diagnoses a deployed KB only.

queries.query: My KB retrieves documents but the answers are low quality, improve them
queries.rationale: Retrieval-quality complaint; the skill does not measure quality, run eval jobs, or judge correctness.

queries.query: Help me deploy a Lambda function
queries.rationale: Unrelated task with no knowledge base involved.
General informational question with no deployed KB and no symptom to diagnose.
